mapper.sql: select m.member_id, m.phone, m.password, m.pay_password, m.invite_code, m.parent_id, p.invite_code as parent_invite_code, m.ancestors, m.real_name, m.id_card, m.kyc_status, m.level_id, l.level_name, m.status, m.withdraw_status, m.test_flag, m.ga_secret, m.ga_status, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, (select ifnull(w.available, 0) from biz_wallet w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.type_code = 'BALANCE' and w.currency = 'CNY') as cny_available, (select ifnull(sum(w.frozen), 0) from biz_wallet w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.currency = 'CNY') as cny_frozen, (select ifnull(w.available, 0) from biz_wallet w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.type_code = 'PRODUCT' and w.currency = 'CNY') as cny_product_income, (select ifnull(w.available, 0) from biz_wallet w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.type_code = 'PROMO' and w.currency = 'CNY') as cny_assist_value, (select ifnull(w.available, 0) from biz_wallet w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.type_code = 'BALANCE' and w.currency = 'USDT') as usdt_available, (select ifnull(sum(w.frozen), 0) from biz_wallet w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.currency = 'USDT') as usdt_frozen, (select ifnull(w.available, 0) from biz_wallet w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.type_code = 'PRODUCT' and w.currency = 'USDT') as usdt_product_income, (select ifnull(w.available, 0) from biz_wallet w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.type_code = 'PROMO' and w.currency = 'USDT') as usdt_assist_value, (select count(1) from biz_member t where find_in_set(m.member_id, t.ancestors) and ifnull(t.test_flag, '0') = '0') as team_count, (select count(1) from biz_member d where d.parent_id = m.member_id and ifnull(d.test_flag, '0') = '0') as direct_count, (select l.login_time from biz_member_logininfor l where l.member_id = m.member_id and l.status = '0' and l.msg = '登录成功' order by l.login_time desc, l.info_id desc limit 1) as last_login_time, (select l.ipaddr from biz_member_logininfor l where l.member_id = m.member_id and l.status = '0' and l.msg = '注册成功' order by l.info_id asc limit 1) as register_ip, (select l.ipaddr from biz_member_logininfor l where l.member_id = m.member_id and l.status = '0' and l.msg = '登录成功' order by l.login_time desc, l.info_id desc limit 1) as last_login_ip from biz_member m left join biz_member p on p.member_id = m.parent_id left join biz_level l on l.level_id = m.level_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_member m where find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0' and m.kyc_status = '1' and exists (select 1 from biz_order o where o.member_id = m.member_id)

select count(1) from biz_member m where find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0'
and (length(ifnull(m.ancestors,'')) - length(replace(ifnull(m.ancestors,''), ',', '')) - ifnull(#{viewerDepth}, 0)) between 1 and #{maxDepth}
and m.kyc_status = '1'
and exists (select 1 from biz_order o where o.member_id = m.member_id)
select count(1) from biz_member where parent_id = #{memberId} and ifnull(test_flag, '0') = '0'

select depth as teamLevel, count(1) as register, ifnull(sum(case when exists (select 1 from biz_order o where o.member_id = t.member_id) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as active from ( select m.member_id, as depth from biz_member m where find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0' ) t where depth between 1 and 7 group by depth

select as teamLevel, ifnull(sum(case when o.currency = 'USDT' then o.price else 0 end), 0) as subscribeUsd, ifnull(sum(case when o.currency = 'USDT' then o.price else 0 end), 0) as subscribeUsdt, ifnull(sum(case when o.currency = 'CNY' then o.price else 0 end), 0) as subscribeCny from biz_order o inner join biz_member m on m.member_id = o.member_id where find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0' and between 1 and 7 group by

select as teamLevel, ifnull(sum(case when r.currency = 'USDT' then r.amount else 0 end), 0) as rechargeUsd, ifnull(sum(case when r.currency = 'USDT' then r.amount else 0 end), 0) as rechargeUsdt, ifnull(sum(case when r.currency = 'CNY' then r.amount else 0 end), 0) as rechargeCny from biz_recharge r inner join biz_member m on m.member_id = r.member_id where r.status = '1' and find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0' and between 1 and 7 group by

select depth as teamLevel, count(1) as register, ifnull(sum(case when exists (select 1 from biz_order o where o.member_id = t.member_id) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as active from ( select m.member_id, as depth from biz_member m where find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0' ) t where depth >= 1 group by depth

select as teamLevel, ifnull(sum(case when o.currency = 'USDT' then o.price else 0 end), 0) as subscribeUsd, ifnull(sum(case when o.currency = 'USDT' then o.price else 0 end), 0) as subscribeUsdt, ifnull(sum(case when o.currency = 'CNY' then o.price else 0 end), 0) as subscribeCny from biz_order o inner join biz_member m on m.member_id = o.member_id where find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0' and >= 1 group by

select as teamLevel, ifnull(sum(case when r.currency = 'USDT' then r.amount else 0 end), 0) as rechargeUsd, ifnull(sum(case when r.currency = 'USDT' then r.amount else 0 end), 0) as rechargeUsdt, ifnull(sum(case when r.currency = 'CNY' then r.amount else 0 end), 0) as rechargeCny from biz_recharge r inner join biz_member m on m.member_id = r.member_id where r.status = '1' and find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0' and >= 1 group by
mapper.sql: select m.member_id, m.parent_id, m.phone, m.real_name, m.id_card, m.kyc_status, m.create_time, (select count(1) from biz_member c where c.parent_id = m.member_id) as child_count, (select count(1) from biz_member t where find_in_set(m.member_id, t.ancestors) and ifnull(t.test_flag, '0') = '0') as team_count, ifnull((select sum(r.amount) from biz_recharge r where r.member_id = m.member_id and r.currency = 'CNY' and r.status = '1'), 0) as recharge_cny, ifnull((select sum(r.amount) from biz_recharge r where r.member_id = m.member_id and r.currency = 'USDT' and r.status = '1'), 0) as recharge_usdt, ifnull((select sum(o.price) from biz_order o where o.member_id = m.member_id and o.currency = 'CNY'), 0) as subscribe_cny, ifnull((select sum(o.price) from biz_order o where o.member_id = m.member_id and o.currency = 'USDT'), 0) as subscribe_usdt, ifnull((select sum(w.amount) from biz_withdraw w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.currency = 'CNY' and w.status = '1'), 0) as withdraw_cny, ifnull((select sum(w.amount) from biz_withdraw w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.currency = 'USDT' and w.status = '1'), 0) as withdraw_usdt, (select l.login_time from biz_member_logininfor l where l.member_id = m.member_id and l.status = '0' and l.msg = '登录成功' order by l.login_time desc, l.info_id desc limit 1) as last_login_time, (select l.ipaddr from biz_member_logininfor l where l.member_id = m.member_id and l.status = '0' and l.msg = '登录成功' order by l.login_time desc, l.info_id desc limit 1) as last_login_ip, (select l.ipaddr from biz_member_logininfor l where l.member_id = m.member_id and l.status = '0' and l.msg = '注册成功' order by l.info_id asc limit 1) as register_ip from biz_member m
mapper.select: select (select count(1) from biz_member t where find_in_set(#{memberId}, t.ancestors) and ifnull(t.test_flag, '0') = '0') as teamCount, (select count(1) from biz_member d where d.parent_id = #{memberId} and ifnull(d.test_flag, '0') = '0') as directCount, (select count(1) from biz_member d where d.parent_id = #{memberId} and ifnull(d.test_flag, '0') = '0' and exists (select 1 from biz_order o where o.member_id = d.member_id)) as directActive, (select count(1) from biz_member t where find_in_set(#{memberId}, t.ancestors) and ifnull(t.test_flag, '0') = '0' and t.kyc_status = '1') as teamKyc, (select ifnull(sum(case when o.currency = 'CNY' then o.price else 0 end), 0) from biz_order o inner join biz_member m on m.member_id = o.member_id where find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0') as subscribeCny, (select ifnull(sum(case when o.currency = 'USDT' then o.price else 0 end), 0) from biz_order o inner join biz_member m on m.member_id = o.member_id where find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0') as subscribeUsdt, (select ifnull(sum(case when r.currency = 'CNY' then r.amount else 0 end), 0) from biz_recharge r inner join biz_member m on m.member_id = r.member_id where r.status = '1' and find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0') as rechargeCny, (select ifnull(sum(case when r.currency = 'USDT' then r.amount else 0 end), 0) from biz_recharge r inner join biz_member m on m.member_id = r.member_id where r.status = '1' and find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0') as rechargeUsdt, (select ifnull(sum(case when w.currency = 'CNY' then w.amount else 0 end), 0) from biz_withdraw w inner join biz_member m on m.member_id = w.member_id where w.status = '1' and find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0') as withdrawCny, (select ifnull(sum(case when w.currency = 'USDT' then w.amount else 0 end), 0) from biz_withdraw w inner join biz_member m on m.member_id = w.member_id where w.status = '1' and find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0') as withdrawUsdt from (select 1) dummy
